newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to enjoy robust growth - Evans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to enjoy robust growth - Evans.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said Australia should continue to enjoy quite robust growth during the process of reducing the budget deficit by the equivalent of 1.5 percent of GDP over the next two years.
Evans also said the budget forecast for business investment was impressive, but was warranted by the fundamentals and well supported by the expectations survey.

Evans said the reason the budget deficit was not being returned to balance in one year was a matter of balancing risks and objectives, and the short term impact of such a substantial fiscal shock may yield unpredictable results.

Evans said while Australia did not need to take on the substantial risk of cutting the budget so dramatically in just one year, "we nevertheless require urgent fiscal consolidation, amounting to 1.5 percent of GDP over two years."
"For these reason, this course can be pursued as now proposed, while continuing to enjoy quite robust growth in the short term," Evans said.
